property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and a callee contract that always returns success to calls, C.transfer always returns true; the mutant that returns false violates this by returning false for those inputs.

For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer(...) always returns true (completes without reverting and returns true); the mutant returns false early for some inputs, so a call that succeeds will have a differing boolean return value (true in reference, false in mutant).
